description: Measures RulesCompiler parse coverage over human-equivalent paraphrases. Every paraphrase in a group asks the same question as the canonical. The compiled-rate is a MEASUREMENT of regex-template brittleness, not a pass/fail gate; only the canonical phrasings gate (they must compile to the expected parse). Deliberately carries NO per-paraphrase expectations - baking in 'known_parser_failure' would freeze current compiler behavior into the benchmark definition. Separate track from the legacy eval_paraphrase.py (v1 graffiti_bathroom); NOT comparable to it or to any phase scorecard.
